edges.context: mouse Acan+/-, postnatal; resting zone, proliferative zone, hypertrophic zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)

edges.magnitude: median adult height -2.8 SDS (range -5.9 to -0.9) in 103 individuals from 20 families with heterozygous ACAN loss of function, with advanced bone age and early growth cessation
edges.context: human, mixed ancestry, both sexes, heterozygous ACAN loss-of-function variants; prehypertrophic zone, hypertrophic zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), juvenile
edges.notes: One of the few places where a single matrix protein's dosage is quantitatively tied to human adult stature. ACAN haploinsufficiency is among the commonest monogenic causes of idiopathic short stature.

edges.magnitude: growth plates severely abnormal and disorganised with disruption of normal columnar cellular relationships, and decreased aggrecan deposition in the matrix
edges.context: mouse, Prx1-Cre limb-mesoderm-specific Has2 conditional null; embryonic and perinatal limb; proliferative zone, sex unknown (not reported in source)
edges.notes: Hyaluronan is the backbone filament of the aggrecan aggregate, so this is also the aggregate's architectural phenotype - aggrecan cannot be retained without it.

edges.magnitude: striking reduction in the NUMBER of hypertrophic chondrocytes and in the expression domains of hypertrophic differentiation markers
edges.context: mouse, Prx1-Cre Has2 conditional null limb; hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)

edges.magnitude: all limb skeletal elements severely shortened; proximal phalanges duplicated (a patterning effect separable from the growth effect)
edges.context: mouse, Prx1-Cre Has2 conditional null limb; proliferative zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)

edges.magnitude: significantly reduced aggrecan deposition in the hypertrophic zone and decreased numbers of prehypertrophic AND hypertrophic chondrocytes; mice dwarfed with delayed bone formation, small epiphyses and flared metaphyses
edges.context: mouse, Crtl1(Hapln1) targeted null; most homozygotes die perinatally of respiratory failure, survivors develop progressive dwarfism and cervical lordosis; hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)
edges.notes: Link protein does nothing but clamp the aggrecan G1 domain onto hyaluronan, so its null phenotype isolates the contribution of AGGREGATE STABILITY (as opposed to aggrecan abundance) to zonal architecture. The radiographic picture is a spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia.

edges.magnitude: decreased numbers of prehypertrophic chondrocytes
edges.context: mouse Crtl1(Hapln1) null; prehypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)

edges.magnitude: severe chondrodysplasia with disorganised growth plate columns and reduced fibrillar collagen, in a tissue that has no basement membranes at all
edges.context: mouse, Hspg2 homozygous null; human functional-null HSPG2 causes dyssegmental dysplasia Silverman-Handmaker, hypomorphic alleles cause Schwartz-Jampel syndrome; proliferative zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), fetal, neonatal, juvenile (E8-E13.5; P0-P21)
edges.notes: Perlecan is a core pericellular matrix component and also the reservoir that presents FGF-2 to the chondrocyte, so the architectural phenotype is not cleanly structural.

edges.magnitude: severe chondrodysplasia; a human allelic series in which complete loss is lethal-severe and hypomorphic loss is mild
edges.context: mouse null; human DDSH vs Schwartz-Jampel; proliferative zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), sex unknown (not reported in source), fetal, neonatal, juvenile (E8-E13.5; P0-P21)

edges.magnitude: Col2a1-null mice produce structurally abnormal cartilage that LACKS growth plates in long bones, and develop a skeleton with no endochondral bone formation
edges.context: mouse, Col2a1 homozygous null, embryonic; resting zone, hypertrophic zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), sex unknown (not reported in source)
edges.notes: The most absolute matrix requirement in this seam: without collagen II there is no growth plate to have architecture. Human COL2A1 mutations are hypomorphic or dominant-negative rather than null, which is why type II collagenopathies are epiphyseal/vertebral dysplasias rather than absence of endochondral bone.

edges.magnitude: in HUMAN juvenile rib growth plate, collagen XI is restricted to fibrils under 25 nm diameter and the hypertrophic zone carries a distinct fibril population; young growth cartilage fibrils are up to 80% collagen II, at least 10% IX and at least 10% XI by mass
edges.context: human juvenile rib growth plate, immunoelectron microscopy; bovine and chicken for the mass fractions; hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source)
edges.notes: A rare zonally resolved HUMAN matrix-architecture measurement: fibril composition is not constant across the plate, so a single set of matrix material properties cannot be correct for all zones.

edges.magnitude: Col9a1-null mice have NORMAL skeletal development and only later develop non-inflammatory degenerative joint disease; monoallelic human COL9A2 and COL9A3 variants cause multiple epiphyseal dysplasia (11.8% each of a 22-patient, 17-family series)
edges.context: mouse null; human MED cohort; zone unknown (not reported), both sexes (male and female) (sex reported in 1 of 2 sources), pubertal (11-year-old/15 years old)
edges.notes: Negative for the plate, positive for the epiphysis - the same protein separates two compartments that are usually conflated.

edges.magnitude: 830 patients (471 probands) with COMP variants concentrated in the calcium-binding type 3 repeats; the disease mechanism is intracellular ER retention of misfolded COMP in chondrocytes, not loss of an extracellular structural protein
edges.context: human, heterozygous COMP variants; pseudoachondroplasia (severe) and multiple epiphyseal dysplasia (mild) as one allelic continuum; zone unknown (not reported), both sexes (male and female) (sex reported in 2 of 4 sources), pubertal (11-year-old/15 years old)
edges.notes: Recorded because it inverts the naive matrix logic: the plate fails from a chondrocyte proteostasis defect caused by a matrix gene, so 'matrix protein knockout' intuitions do not transfer. In MED the plate fails structurally without costing much height.

edges.magnitude: MATN3 von Willebrand A domain mutations cause autosomal dominant MED (11.8% of a 22-patient series) by misfolding the A domain and preventing secretion; matrilin-1/matrilin-3 double-deficient mice have abnormally thick and irregular cartilage collagen fibrils
edges.context: human MED cohorts; mouse double null; zone unknown (not reported), both sexes (male and female) (sex reported in 1 of 4 sources), pubertal (14-year-old; 11-year-old/15 years old)
edges.notes: Same proteostasis mechanism as COMP, in a protein that physically sits on the collagen IX surface - and matrilin-3 fails to integrate into matrix at all in collagen IX-null mice, so the COMP/MATN3/COL9 dysplasias are one adaptor network failing in three places.

edges.magnitude: biglycan-null mice have shortened long bones and reduced bone mass, an osteoporosis-like phenotype; Bgn but not Dcn deletion lowers trabecular bone mass
edges.context: mouse, Bgn null; no human BGN growth phenotype established; zone unknown (not reported), male only (sex reported in 1 of 2 sources), adult (10 to 11 months old/6-month-old)

edges.magnitude: decorin-null mice have coarse irregular collagen fibrils and fragile skin, with NO reported growth plate phenotype; Dcn deletion does not lower trabecular bone mass whereas Bgn deletion does
edges.context: mouse, Dcn null; zone unknown (not reported), male only (sex reported in 1 of 2 sources), adult (10 to 11 months old/6-month-old)
edges.notes: A deliberate negative that separates the two class I SLRPs: they are structurally near-identical and skeletally non-equivalent.

edges.magnitude: alpha5beta1 integrin mediates the chondrocyte-fibronectin interaction and modulates proliferation
edges.context: in vitro animal chondrocytes; heterozygous human FN1 mutations cause spondylometaphyseal dysplasia with corner fractures; proliferative zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)

edges.magnitude: Alpl-/- mice have under 1% of wild-type plasma TNAP activity and accumulate PPi, phosphoethanolamine and pyridoxal-5-phosphate; high-resolution TEM places the lesion precisely - mineral crystals still initiate NORMALLY inside matrix vesicles but fail to propagate beyond the vesicle membrane; radiographic rachitic change from about 10 days
edges.context: mouse Alpl homozygous null, 10-day-old tibial growth plate; TNAP activity is immunolocalised to the hypertrophic and calcifying zones in chicken and coincides with maximal organically bound phosphorus in pig; sex unknown (not reported in source), juvenile (10-day-old)
edges.notes: TNAP is required for the EXTRAvesicular step, not the intravesicular one. This is the sharpest mechanistic localisation in the whole mineralization module and it is why hypophosphatasia and XLH produce superficially similar rickets from opposite causes.

edges.magnitude: developmental arrest of chondrocyte differentiation with diminished or absent hypertrophic zones in Alpl-/- mice; in human hypophosphatasia the plate continues to grow but the unmineralised zone widens as rickets
edges.context: mouse Alpl null; human ALPL loss-of-function; hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), childhood, adult (3-year-old/51-year-old/7 years old)

edges.magnitude: PPi adsorbs to nascent apatite crystal faces and blocks crystal proliferation and growth; human plasma PPi is 3.50 +/- 0.11 umol/L (99% range 1.19-5.65) and the working range in tissue is 1-6 uM
edges.context: human plasma (73 healthy adults); mouse and rat growth plate chondrocytes; the master physiological mineralization inhibitor; hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)
edges.notes: Mineralization in the plate is not controlled by mineral supply - the extracellular Ca x P ion product in pig growth plate is far above the ~2 mM^2 needed in vitro. It is controlled by where the inhibitor is destroyed.

edges.magnitude: extracellular Pi stimulated terminal differentiation marker genes (ank, alkaline phosphatase, MMP-13, osteocalcin, Runx2), mineralization and apoptosis, dependent on concentration and on type III Na/Pi cotransporter (Pit-1) expression; LOWER Pi sufficed for differentiation, HIGHER Pi was required for apoptosis; Pit-1 suppression abolished the effect
edges.context: growth plate chondrocytes in culture; extracellular Pi is highest in the growth plate immediately before mineralization onset; species unknown, hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)
edges.notes: Makes phosphate an instructive signal rather than a substrate: the Pi/PPi ratio sets the timing of terminal differentiation, not merely whether apatite forms. Directly relevant to why XLH (low Pi) impairs hypertrophy as well as mineralization.

edges.magnitude: high extracellular Pi was required for stimulation of apoptosis of growth plate chondrocytes; PPi opposed it
edges.context: growth plate chondrocytes in culture, dose-separated from the differentiation effect; species unknown, hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)
edges.notes: Ties the mineralization module to the terminal fate decision at the chondro-osseous junction.

edges.magnitude: the first apatite crystal of the growth plate forms inside 30-200 nm vesicles budded into the longitudinal septa of the LOWER hypertrophic zone; Phospho1-/-;Alpl-/- double nulls have NO detectable skeletal mineral at all, while each single null retains some
edges.context: mouse, chicken and rat matrix vesicle preparations; mouse double null is perinatal lethal; hypertrophic zone, both sexes (male and female) (sex reported in 1 of 3 sources), fetal, neonatal, juvenile, adult (10-day-old; E16.5; P1-P20; 1-day-old/1-month-old/1-year-old)
edges.notes: Genetically separable two-stage model: intravesicular initiation (PHOSPHO1, Pi influx) then extravesicular propagation (TNAP holding PPi low). The double null is the proof that these are the only two routes.

edges.magnitude: PHOSPHO1 is the cytosolic, matrix-vesicle-enclosed phosphatase specific for phosphoethanolamine and phosphocholine that supplies intravesicular Pi; its pharmacological inhibition impairs skeletal mineralization in chick limb development, and Phospho1-/- tibiae have reduced elastic modulus and hardness by nanoindentation
edges.context: mouse Phospho1 null; chicken limb development; PHOSPHO1 ablation alters the growth plate lipidome in all three zones by MALDI imaging; hypertrophic zone, both sexes (male and female) (sex reported in 2 of 5 sources), fetal, neonatal, juvenile, adult (E16.5; P1-P20; 1-day-old/1-month-old/1-year-old; 12 weeks old/3–4 week)

edges.magnitude: ENPP1 hydrolyses ATP to AMP plus PPi and is the required source of extracellular PPi: Enpp1-/- mouse bone contains under 2.5% of wild-type PPi
edges.context: mouse Enpp1 null; human ENPP1 loss of function causes generalised arterial calcification of infancy AND autosomal recessive hypophosphatemic rickets type 2 from the same alleles; hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)
edges.notes: The opposing arm to TNAP on the same PPi pool. The 2022 revision showed ANKH exports ATP rather than PPi, so ENPP1 rather than ANKH is the proximate PPi generator.

edges.magnitude: blocking Ank in terminal growth plate chondrocytes raises extracellular PPi and blocks mineralization; ANK expression in growth plate chondrocytes is oxygen-tension dependent and HIF-1 mediated
edges.context: rat and mouse terminal growth plate chondrocytes; human ANKH disease alleles; hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)
edges.notes: Mechanism revised in 2022: ANKH is an ATP exporter, not a PPi transporter, so its effect on physeal PPi is indirect via ENPP1 substrate supply. ANK is absent from matrix vesicles, which is why ank loss cannot rescue Alpl-/-.

edges.magnitude: osteopontin inhibits hydroxyapatite formation and growth in a gelatin gel in vitro; Opn-/-;Mgp-/- double nulls calcify far worse than Mgp-/- alone, establishing additivity; in HUMAN growth plate SPP1 marks the mineralization-INHIBITING epiphyseal boundary
edges.context: in vitro gel; mouse double null; human proteomic and elemental mapping of growth plate from ten paediatric donors (six amputation, four polydactyly); hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), infant, childhood (0–5 years old/6–14 years old)

edges.magnitude: Mgp-/- mice calcify their growth plate cartilage and their arteries and die within two months - inappropriate mineralization of zones that are normally unmineralized
edges.context: mouse Mgp null; MGP is also among the genes upregulated in the cartilage layer that suppresses calcification of the deep layer in bovine osteochondral explants; zone unknown (not reported), sex unknown (not reported in source), adult (2–3 year old/2–3 years old/6-8-month-old)
edges.notes: The mirror-image experiment to hypophosphatasia: removing an inhibitor mineralizes the wrong zones, removing the inhibitor-destroyer leaves the right zone unmineralized. Zonal mineralization is set by inhibitor placement, not by mineral availability.

edges.magnitude: AHSG concentrates at the growth-plate/epiphysis interface in human tissue, where mineralization is actively inhibited; Ahsg-null mice develop widespread ectopic calcification; fetuin-A works by forming soluble colloidal calciprotein particles rather than by adsorbing to crystal faces
edges.context: human growth plate proteomics (10 paediatric donors); mouse Ahsg null; liver-derived, reaches cartilage from the circulation; hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), infant, childhood (0–5 years old/6–14 years old)

edges.magnitude: longitudinal septa mineralize while transverse septa do not, converting cartilage into the scaffold the capillary bud and osteoblasts then occupy; extracellular sulphur (sulphated proteoglycan proxy) falls from 3.5% to 0.3% of dry mass on mineralization; the human GP-metaphysis interface shows a GRADUAL modulus rise (416 -> 3220 MPa) enriched in ENPP1 and ALPL, whereas the GP-epiphysis interface shows a SHARP step (131 -> 11920 MPa) and is an active inhibition zone
edges.context: porcine electron microprobe (althoff1982); human AFM plus proteomics on 10 paediatric donors (xie2025); hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), infant, childhood (0–5 years old/6–14 years old)
edges.notes: The plate is mineralization-POLARISED, not merely mineralization-terminated. Both boundaries carry inhibitors; what differs is whether TNAP and ENPP1 are present to override them.

edges.magnitude: mineral appears first as amorphous calcium phosphate, transiently stabilised by inhibitory proteins, then converted to oriented apatite platelets templated by collagen charge clusters in the 40 nm gap zone
edges.context: in vitro collagen templating (nudetlman-type cryo-TEM); porcine growth plate microprobe for the ionic environment; species unknown, hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)
edges.timescale: minutes to hours per crystal, continuous at tissue level

edges.magnitude: chondron bending and kinking is largest at the reserve/proliferative interface, which is also where the porcine unconfined-compression data place the largest step in zonal stiffness (RZ stiffest; PZ and HZ 0.5x axially, 0.33x transversely, permeability 3x higher)
edges.context: bovine compressed physis for the deformation (vendra2018); newborn porcine distal ulna, transversely isotropic biphasic model, for the stiffness (sergerie2009); species unknown, resting zone, hypertrophic zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), sex unknown (not reported in source), neonatal
edges.notes: Two species, two methods, one inferred correspondence. Recorded at low confidence because the DIRECTION of the zonal stiffness gradient is itself disputed (see e00098).

edges.context: rabbit, porcine, bovine and human; no zone, stage or sex can be specified because the underlying measurement is not agreed; hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), neonatal, infant, childhood, adult (0–5 years old/6–14 years old; 9-week-old)
edges.notes: Published growth plate moduli span 0.38 MPa (rabbit tissue-scale microindentation) to 416 MPa (human sharp-tip AFM) - three orders of magnitude - and the DIRECTION of the zonal gradient is not agreed: porcine unconfined compression makes the reserve zone stiffest, rabbit microindentation puts the peak in the upper hypertrophic zone, rabbit cranial base AFM has modulus rising monotonically to the mineralizing zone. Until that is resolved, no stiffness-to-behaviour relation in the plate can be stated with a sign, which is why this edge is written speculative rather than given a direction.

edges.magnitude: Mmp9-null growth plates lengthen progressively to about EIGHT TIMES normal before three weeks postnatal, then normalise after three weeks by compensatory apoptosis and vascularisation
edges.context: mouse Mmp9 null; MMP-9 is supplied by invading marrow-derived chondroclasts/septoclasts, not by chondrocytes; hypertrophic zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)
edges.timescale: transient: accumulates to 3 weeks postnatal, resolved thereafter
edges.notes: The largest single-gene effect on growth plate height in this atlas, and it is a REMOVAL rate defect, not a production defect. No human MMP9 deficiency syndrome is known, so the mechanism has no human genetic anchor.

edges.magnitude: hypertrophic chondrocytes differentiate normally but their apoptosis, the vascular invasion and the ossification are all delayed; the defect is cell-extrinsic to cartilage and is rescued by wild-type bone marrow transplantation
edges.context: mouse Mmp9 null with marrow transplant rescue; hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)

edges.magnitude: Mmp9-null growth plates in culture show delayed release of a matrix-bound angiogenic activator
edges.context: mouse Mmp9 null growth plate culture; hypertrophic zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)

edges.magnitude: Mmp13-null mice have MARKEDLY INCREASED hypertrophic domains with significant interstitial collagen accumulation, plus delayed endochondral ossification and delayed formation and vascularisation of primary ossification centres; the abnormality persists into adulthood and phenocopies human hereditary chondrodysplasias
edges.context: mouse Mmp13 null; MMP-13 is the chondrocyte-intrinsic collagenase of the hypertrophic zone; sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)
edges.notes: Contrast with Mmp9: MMP-13 is made by the chondrocyte and its loss is permanent; MMP-9 comes from invading marrow cells and its loss is compensated after 3 weeks. Different cellular sources, different persistence.

edges.magnitude: absence of Mmp13 causes significant interstitial collagen accumulation from lack of the collagenase-mediated cleavage that normally occurs in growth plates and primary ossification centres
edges.context: mouse Mmp13 null; authentic matrix vesicles also contain active MMP-13 capable of activating latent TGF-beta; hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)

edges.magnitude: a novel human MMP13 frameshift variant causes short stature via ENHANCED MMP13-HSPA5 interaction and activated ER stress - a gain of interaction, not a simple loss of proteolysis
edges.context: human, single kindred; hypertrophic zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), both sexes (male and female), neonatal, juvenile, pubertal
edges.notes: Sign is left unknown deliberately. The mouse null (more hypertrophic zone) and the human variant (short stature) do not have a common direction because the human mechanism is proteostatic, like COMP and MATN3, rather than proteolytic.

edges.magnitude: Mmp14-null mice develop dwarfism, osteopenia, generalised arthritis and connective tissue disease from inadequate collagen turnover - the most severe skeletal phenotype of any single MMP; MMP-14 is the most prominent MMP in the HUMAN child and adolescent growth plate and is present in all zones
edges.context: mouse global null; human growth plate immunolocalisation across zones; hypertrophic zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), sex unknown (not reported in source), juvenile, pubertal, adult
edges.notes: The severity is partly non-chondrocytic: global but not chondrocyte-specific MT1-MMP deficiency causes the inflammatory arthritis, so the dwarfism and the arthritis are separable.

edges.context: mouse hypertrophic chondrocytes for the swelling measurement; bovine and human articular cartilage for the osmotic parameters - no zone-resolved measurement in a growth plate; sex unknown (not reported in source), adult
edges.notes: Quantitative phase microscopy shows the middle phase of chondrocyte enlargement is massive fluid uptake diluting cellular dry mass by about 60%. Cartilage fixed charge density is -0.19 to -0.35 M and in situ osmotic pressure is about one third of the ideal Donnan prediction. Whether the swelling gradient is generated cell-autonomously by intracellular solute accumulation or by a change in matrix fixed charge around the hypertrophying cell has not been tested - the measurements exist in different tissues and have never been made in the same specimen.

edges.context: human, porcine and mouse pericellular matrix data; bovine chondron deformation; no growth plate experiment manipulates the pericellular matrix and reads out hypertrophic cell volume; sex unknown (not reported in source), fetal (E17.5)
edges.notes: The standard account of why hypertrophy elongates a bone rather than widening it is that the laterally confining matrix channels volume increase along the growth axis. The pericellular matrix has a modulus about 0.35x that of the interterritorial matrix and chondrons bend rather than compress uniformly, both of which bear on that account, but no experiment has tested it.

edges.context: human turnover numbers come from ADULT ARTICULAR cartilage; the septal removal rate comes from rat proximal tibia; the two have never been measured in the same tissue; hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source)
edges.timescale: mismatched by three orders of magnitude - see notes
edges.notes: Aggrecan monomer half-life in adult human articular cartilage is 3.4 years and free G1 half-life is 25 years. A rat proximal tibial column removes one septum per 3 cells per hour, i.e. the entire matrix of a column transits and is destroyed in days. These two numbers cannot both describe growth plate proteoglycan, and no growth-plate-specific human turnover measurement exists. This is a scale gap, and quoting articular half-lives for physeal matrix is a defect that appears in reviews.

edges.magnitude: Adamts4/Adamts5 DOUBLE knockout mice are physiologically normal and protected from surgical osteoarthritis; separately, mice engineered with aggrecan resistant to MMP cleavage at the N341-F342 interglobular-domain site grow normally and do not accumulate aggrecan
edges.context: mouse; two independent genetic strategies, both negative for skeletal growth; zone unknown (not reported), sex unknown (not reported in source), adult (1-year-old)
edges.notes: A double negative with real consequences: neither aggrecanase-mediated nor MMP-mediated aggrecanolysis is required to remove aggrecan from the hypertrophic zone before mineralization, so the actual removal mechanism is unidentified (g_l6l5_006). Dilution by matrix expansion and ADAMTS cleavage at Glu373-Ala374 in a redundant configuration are the surviving candidates.

edges.context: porcine microprobe (66% tissue fluid, assumed not measured zonally) and mouse; no zonally resolved water measurement in any growth plate, human or animal; zone unknown (not reported), sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)
edges.notes: The plate is avascular, so every solute a chondrocyte needs crosses a dense polyanionic gel by diffusion, and water is the medium. Water content is the least quantified variable in L5: 66% is an assumed value in the microprobe study, and MR T1 mapping can measure physeal water to 97.3% accuracy against freeze-drying but has not been applied zonally.

edges.context: bovine fixed-charge-density measurements in articular cartilage; no solute transport measurement in growth plate matrix in any species; bovine, resting zone, proliferative zone, hypertrophic zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), sex unknown (not reported in source), adult
edges.notes: Aggrecan carries essentially all the fixed negative charge of cartilage (-0.19 to -0.35 M), which must retard anionic solutes and concentrate cations by Donnan partition. Oxygen and glucose gradients across the plate are measured; the charge-dependence of solute transport in physeal matrix specifically is not.

edges.context: mouse Lox null - perinatal lethal from aortic aneurysm and diaphragmatic defects before any growth plate readout is possible; zone unknown (not reported), sex unknown (not reported in source), neonatal
edges.notes: Lysyl oxidase initiates every covalent collagen crosslink, and cartilage collagen II is crosslinked head-to-tail by hydroxylysyl pyridinoline at two telopeptide sites. The global null dies before the growth plate can be assessed, so a cartilage-specific conditional is the missing experiment. This is a method-blocked gap, not an absence of interest.

edges.magnitude: inactivating PHEX mutations raise circulating FGF23, which suppresses renal phosphate reabsorption and 1-alpha-hydroxylation of vitamin D, producing chronic hypophosphataemia
edges.context: human, X-linked dominant PHEX loss of function; systemic rather than zone-local; hypertrophic zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), both sexes (male and female) (sex reported in 1 of 2 sources), infant, childhood, pubertal, adult (0–1 year old/0–12 years old/1 year old; mean age 8.3 year)
edges.notes: The mirror of hypophosphatasia: in HPP the inhibitor is not destroyed, in XLH the substrate is not supplied. Both give rachitic widening of the unmineralized zone, from opposite sides of the same equation - which is why serum phosphate, not radiographs, distinguishes them.

edges.magnitude: insufficient extracellular phosphate for apatite deposition at the zone of provisional calcification, plus impaired hypertrophy
edges.context: human PHEX loss of function; growth plate, hypertrophic and calcifying zones; both sexes (male and female) (sex reported in 1 of 3 sources), infant, childhood, pubertal, adult (0–1 year old/0–12 years old/1 year old; mean age 8.3 year)
edges.notes: The hypertrophy component is not merely a consequence of failed mineralization: extracellular Pi independently drives terminal differentiation via Pit-1 (kim2010), so low Pi hits both steps.

edges.magnitude: lysosomal enzyme deficiency blocks glycosaminoglycan catabolism so keratan sulphate and chondroitin-6-sulphate (MPS IVA, Morquio A) or heparan sulphate (MPS IIIA, Sanfilippo A) accumulate in chondrocyte lysosomes and in the extracellular matrix
edges.context: human, autosomal recessive lysosomal enzyme deficiencies; postnatally acquired growth failure with normal birth length; zone unknown (not reported), sex unknown (not reported in source), juvenile
edges.notes: The only human experiment in which growth plate matrix is progressively poisoned from within by undegraded substrate rather than by a missing structural component. Keratan sulphate and chondroitin-6-sulphate are the aggrecan glycosaminoglycans, so MPS IVA is in effect a defect of aggrecan CATABOLISM - the step that e00109 shows is otherwise unidentified.

edges.magnitude: MATN3 accounts for 11.8% of a 22-patient, 17-family MED series; von Willebrand A domain mutations misfold the A domain and prevent secretion of the mutant protein
edges.context: human, autosomal dominant MED; MATN3 alongside COMP (47%), COL9A2 and COL9A3 (11.8% each), SLC26A2 (17.6%) and CANT1 (11.8%); zone unknown (not reported), both sexes (male and female) (sex reported in 1 of 3 sources), pubertal (14-year-old; 11-year-old/15 years old)
edges.notes: Fills the MATN3 arm of the MED aetiology that the existing COMP-only edges left open.

edges.magnitude: monoallelic COL9A2 and COL9A3 variants account for 11.8% each in a 22-patient, 17-family MED series
edges.context: human, autosomal dominant MED; contrast with Col9a1-null mice which have normal skeletal development; zone unknown (not reported), both sexes (male and female) (sex reported in 1 of 2 sources), pubertal (11-year-old/15 years old)
edges.notes: Human dominant COL9 alleles cause epiphyseal disease that the mouse null does not - a dominant-negative rather than loss-of-function mechanism, consistent with matrilin-3 failing to integrate into matrix when collagen IX is absent.

edges.magnitude: sharp-tip AFM (9 nm tip radius, 26 N/m cantilever, 6 uN peak force, Hertz conical fit) on 150 um hydrated human cryosections gives 130.7 +/- 36.6 MPa (resting zone) and 416.2 +/- 107.2 MPa (hypertrophic zone); tissue-scale hydrated microindentation of 9-week rabbit proximal tibia gives 380-690 kPa - a 300- to 1000-fold difference on the same tissue class
edges.context: human phalangeal (0-5 y) and tibial (6-14 y) growth plates, 10 donors, n=3 per interface; rabbit proximal tibia n=15; resting zone, hypertrophic zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), sex unknown (not reported in source), infant, childhood, adult (0–5 years old/6–14 years old; 9-week-old)
edges.notes: The single largest source of the three-order-of-magnitude spread in published physeal stiffness: a nanoscale sharp tip probes local mineralised/fibrillar matrix with no time for interstitial fluid to redistribute, while tissue-scale indentation probes a poroelastic continuum. These are different physical quantities reported under one word. Any L6 model that consumes a modulus must state the length scale.

edges.magnitude: newborn porcine distal ulna by unconfined compression stress-relaxation with a transversely isotropic biphasic model makes the RESERVE zone the stiffest: proliferative and hypertrophic zones 0.5x axially, 0.33x transversely, with 3x higher radial permeability
edges.context: newborn porcine distal ulna; species unknown, resting zone, hypertrophic zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), sex unknown (not reported in source), neonatal
edges.notes: Opposite in DIRECTION to rabbit microindentation (peak in upper hypertrophic zone) and to human sharp-tip AFM (monotonic rise to the hypertrophic zone). Species, age, hydration, loading rate and constitutive model all differ; none of the three is a human weight-bearing physis measured hydrated at tissue scale.

edges.magnitude: every human physeal stress figure in the literature is model output; the tension-band-plate model of the femoral physis during guided growth is stated by its authors as not fully participant-specific
edges.context: human geometry, in silico; guided growth, gait-driven femoral models, foot progression angle models; resting zone, proliferative zone, hypertrophic zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), sex unknown (not reported in source), infant, juvenile, pubertal (11 years old; 20-month-old)
edges.notes: The models are unavoidable - the measurement is impossible (g_l6mech_003) - but they consume the animal stress-growth coefficient as an input, so a model cannot be used to validate the coefficient without circularity.

edges.magnitude: the entire matched-mean-strain static/dynamic contrast exists only in explants: 10% static vs 7-13% at 0.1 Hz for 48 h in swine ulna, and a stress-relaxation plus confocal protocol varying frequency and amplitude in the same model
edges.context: porcine ulnar growth plate explants, 4-week-old animals, bioreactor; species unknown, proliferative zone, hypertrophic zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), sex unknown (not reported in source), peripubertal (4-week-old; 4-week-old)
edges.notes: Explants are the only format in which a defined stimulus can be applied to a growth plate without systemic confounding, and they are also where the static/dynamic result INVERTS relative to in vivo (e00009). Method and finding cannot be separated here.

edges.magnitude: viability falls with compression magnitude, duration, frequency and amplitude; proliferative and hypertrophic chondrocytes are the most sensitive zones
edges.context: swine ulnar growth plate explants, n=60 across 10 loading groups; species unknown, hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)
edges.notes: A method-artefact edge: above a threshold an explant loading experiment measures zonal cell death rather than mechanobiology, and the most sensitive zones are exactly the ones whose architecture is scored.

edges.magnitude: porcine single-level vertebral body tethering reproduces growth modulation at human-scale plate dimensions: 53% vs -1% at 2 weeks for high vs low tether tension (p=0.03), collapsing to 14% vs 10% (p=0.6) over weeks 2-4
edges.context: kyphotic swine model, posterior vertebral body tethering; human and pig, resting zone, proliferative zone, hypertrophic zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), sex unknown (not reported in source), neonatal, childhood (10–11-week-old/11-week-old/13-week-old)
edges.notes: The pig is the only model whose physeal dimensions and loading approach human scale, and it reproduces both the law and its two-week escape.

edges.magnitude: the entire stress-growth linearity result (17.1%/0.1 MPa, range 9.2-23.9) comes from rat, rabbit and calf caudal vertebrae and proximal tibiae loaded by an external apparatus over approximately 0.02-0.2 MPa
edges.context: rat, rabbit, bovine; two skeletal sites; immature animals; zone unknown (not reported), sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)
edges.notes: The applied stress range was chosen for the apparatus, not for physiology, so the linear window is an artefact of the method as much as a property of the plate (g_l6mech_002). Rats do not fuse their physes, which further limits what an 8-day rat window can say about a human plate that must run for 15 years and then close.

edges.magnitude: transphyseal bony bridges counted and their density quantified in mouse tibiae; bony bar accumulation followed over 42 days on a validated 5-point radiological and histological scale in the mouse distal femoral drill-hole model
edges.context: mouse tibia and distal femur; micro-CT images mineral, and the plate is defined by its absence of mineral; proliferative zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), male only (sex reported in 1 of 2 sources), adult (13-month-old)
edges.notes: Micro-CT reports the plate as a radiolucent gap, so it measures the bar and the gap geometry well and the cartilage itself not at all. Every quantitative bar phenotype in this atlas is therefore a mineral measurement.

edges.magnitude: the polarised-mineralization model - SPP1 and AHSG at the inhibiting epiphyseal boundary, ENPP1 and ALPL alongside them at the promoting metaphyseal boundary - rests on ONE human study of ten paediatric donors (six amputations for osteosarcoma or trauma, four polydactyly)
edges.context: human growth plate, proteomic plus elemental mapping; ToF-SIMS imaging as the second human dataset; hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), infant, childhood (0–5 years old/6–14 years old)
edges.notes: The most important recent human result in L5 has n=10 donors and no independent replication. Four of the ten are polydactylous digits, which are not weight-bearing physes.

edges.magnitude: a donor census across the atlas bibliography plus a Europe PMC title sweep located 30 studies examining human growth plate tissue directly; the 21 that state donor counts sum to 259 donors, 157 of them fetal or perinatal autopsy specimens; the human physeal AFM stiffness dataset uses 10 donors with n=3 per interface
edges.context: human; census executed 2026-08-05; zones resolved in source: resting zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), fetal, neonatal, infant, childhood (0–5 years old/6–14 years old)
edges.notes: The reason no human weight-bearing physis has been measured hydrated at tissue scale is supply, not method. This is what makes g_l6l5_005 a method-and-material problem rather than a question awaiting a better instrument.

edges.magnitude: decalcification, mandatory wherever the hypertrophic zone or chondro-osseous junction is included, degrades epitopes; the polyanionic proteoglycan matrix binds cationic antibodies non-specifically
edges.context: human growth plate immunohistochemistry, the basis of most human zonal protein localisation; hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), juvenile, pubertal
edges.notes: Collagen X is chosen as the target because it is the canonical hypertrophic marker AND is localised in exactly the decalcified compartment. The same caveat applies to every human zonal matrix protein claim in L5, including the sergerie2011 loading result which is also IHC-based.

edges.magnitude: phase-contrast microtomography at 2.75 um voxel size with 0.65 um validation tomographs resolves individual chondrocytes, cell density and cell angle inside intact, unsectioned human cartilage from 49 deceased donors plus 4 arthroplasty patients
edges.context: human knee cartilage; the only 3D method that avoids sectioning artefact for chondron geometry; proliferative zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), both sexes (male and female) (sex reported in 1 of 2 sources), age/stage unknown (not reported)
edges.notes: Applied to articular, not physeal, cartilage so far. It is the obvious instrument for resolving the chondron-bending account of column formation (e00055) in a human plate.

edges.magnitude: two doses separated by a known interval leave two fluorescent lines whose separation divided by the interval gives the mineral apposition rate at the advancing chondro-osseous junction, i.e. tissue-level longitudinal growth rate in vivo
edges.context: rat; oxytetracycline label displacement is also the readout for the entire stress-growth coefficient literature; hypertrophic zone, male only (sex reported in 1 of 2 sources), age/stage unknown (not reported)
edges.notes: The method that makes the L6 seam quantitative at all: every percent-per-MPa figure in this shard is ultimately a distance between two tetracycline lines. It cannot be used in children.

edges.context: mouse HZ; PKG-I/II transcripts are far higher in hypertrophic than proliferative or resting chondrocytes, which is the leading explanation for the zonal partition of the CNP effect; sex unknown (not reported in source), fetal (E15.5)

edges.magnitude: median adult height -2.8 SDS (range -5.9 to -0.9) in 103 individuals from 20 families with heterozygous ACAN loss of function, with advanced bone age and early growth cessation
edges.context: human, mixed ancestry, both sexes, heterozygous ACAN loss-of-function variants; resting zone, proliferative zone, hypertrophic zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), juvenile
edges.notes: One of the few places where a single matrix protein's dosage is quantitatively tied to human adult stature. ACAN haploinsufficiency is among the commonest monogenic causes of idiopathic short stature.

edges.magnitude: height z -1.8 +/- 1.1 in 16 carriers vs -0.4 +/- 0.8 in 23 non-carriers (P<0.0005)
edges.context: human, heterozygous NPR2 loss-of-function carriers within a 39-member acromesomelic dysplasia family, both sexes; germline; zone unknown (not reported), age/stage unknown (not reported)

edges.magnitude: no detectable cGMP after CNP stimulation for all three mutants; significant reduction when co-expressed 1:1 with wild type

edges.magnitude: ligand-independent cGMP generation and elevated blood cGMP; tall stature with macrodactyly (V883M) or extreme tall stature without deformity (R655C)

edges.magnitude: plasma CNP doubled versus five controls; NPPC substantially overexpressed in fibroblasts, with skeletal overgrowth

edges.magnitude: significant reduction in cGMP synthesis by the mutant ligands; screen of 668 patients plus 29 ISS families

edges.magnitude: graded constitutive kinase activation across four disorders; adult height 132 cm (M) / 124 cm (F) in achondroplasia

edges.magnitude: tall stature with camptodactyly, scoliosis and hearing loss, recapitulating the Fgfr3-knockout mouse phenotype
edges.context: human, heterozygous FGFR3 p.R621H (and p.R621C in a second family), partial loss of kinase function; CATSHL syndrome, both sexes; prehypertrophic zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), age/stage unknown (not reported)

edges.magnitude: heterozygous carriers show mild-to-moderate short stature with fifth-finger middle phalanx shortening; biallelic loss gives cone-shaped epiphyses of hands and hips

edges.magnitude: three mutated residues predicted to be adjacent on the IHH surface; middle phalanges shortened or absent
edges.context: human, three large families with heterozygous missense mutations in the IHH amino-terminal signalling domain; brachydactyly type A-1; prehypertrophic zone, hypertrophic zone (zonal localization of the interacting nodes, per their localization records), sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)

edges.magnitude: constitutive ligand-independent cAMP accumulation in COS-7 cells, absent in wild type; short-limbed dwarfism with hypercalcaemia and hypophosphataemia

edges.magnitude: mutant receptor well expressed but binds neither PTH nor PTHrP and gives no cAMP or inositol phosphate response; lethal with advanced endochondral maturation

edges.magnitude: brachydactyly type E in 48% and short stature among 103 individuals with 2q37 deletion; penetrance markedly incomplete

edges.magnitude: adult median height -2.8 SDS (range -5.9 to -0.9); childhood median -2.0 SDS (range -4.2 to -0.6)
edges.context: human, 103 individuals from 20 families with heterozygous ACAN loss-of-function variants, both sexes, childhood through adult height; zone unknown (not reported)

edges.notes: Perfect cosegregation of variant and phenotype across 20 families. Bone age is ADVANCED, not delayed, so the mechanism is a shortened growth window rather than a slowed plate.

edges.magnitude: height Z -3.62 +/- 1.95 for missense (dominant-negative) versus -1.99 +/- 1.28 for truncating (haploinsufficient) variants, P=0.013
edges.context: human, 128 metaphyseal chondrodysplasia Schmid cases (4 new plus 124 published), heterozygous, both sexes, at first presentation; hypertrophic zone, infant, childhood, pubertal (1 year old/10.1-year-old/2-year-old; mean age 12 month)
edges.timescale: onset median 12 months for NC1-domain variants versus 72 months for non-NC1 (P=0.0014)

edges.magnitude: mutant chain disrupts trimerisation of normal collagen X, indicating dominant-negative interference rather than simple mRNA decay
edges.context: human, COL10A1 p.W651fsX666 assayed in vitro for trimerisation against wild-type collagen X; hypertrophic zone, sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)

edges.magnitude: disproportionate short stature with platyspondyly and delayed epiphyseal ossification in all seven families
edges.context: human, seven unrelated SEDC families carrying six triple-helical glycine substitutions plus one intronic variant; heterozygous, both sexes; zone unknown (not reported), neonatal, juvenile
edges.notes: No published mean adult height SDS by COL2A1 mutation class exists, which is why no magnitude in SDS is given here. See gap g_l8gen_005.

edges.magnitude: 80.8% of variants missense, 87.7% of probands in the type-3 calcium-binding repeat; PSACH significantly shorter than EDM1 (P<0.001)
edges.context: human, 830 genetically diagnosed PSACH/EDM1 patients (471 probands, 224 COMP variants) aggregated from 106 publications, both sexes; zone unknown (not reported), age/stage unknown (not reported)
edges.notes: Mechanism is misfolding and ER retention of the pentamer, not dosage: this is why COMP missense alleles are far more severe than null alleles.

edges.magnitude: -4 to -10 height SDS with high circulating GH and low IGF-1; only homozygotes express the disease
edges.context: human, homozygous GHR loss-of-function (Laron syndrome), 69-patient cohort of Middle Eastern and Mediterranean origin followed over 50 years, both sexes; zone unknown (not reported), age/stage unknown (not reported)

edges.notes: The largest monogenic stature effect in this atlas. Fixes the causal direction of the somatomedin hypothesis in humans: abolishing the receptor while the ligand is elevated produces near-complete growth failure.

edges.magnitude: height -7.8 SDS (114 cm at 16.4 years) with IGF-1 7.2 ng/ml against a normal range of 242-600, and no response to an IGF-1 generation test
edges.context: human, two unrelated consanguineous pedigrees with homozygous STAT5B mutations; one with total absence of STAT5B protein; zone unknown (not reported), sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)
edges.timescale: postnatal growth failure with growth hormone insensitivity
edges.notes: Places the lesion below the GH receptor: GH and GH-binding protein are normal to elevated while IGF-1 generation fails. Immune dysfunction accompanies it because STAT5B also transduces IL-2 receptor signalling.

edges.magnitude: prepubertal height SDS between -2 and -3, about 1.4 SD below midparental height SDS; pubertal delay in 50%
edges.context: human, 17 patients carrying 14 distinct IGFALS mutations, prepubertal and pubertal, both sexes; zone unknown (not reported)
edges.notes: The key quantitative point is how MILD this is: near-total collapse of the circulating IGF ternary complex costs only ~1.4 SDS, which argues the plate is driven by local rather than circulating IGF-1.

edges.magnitude: extraordinarily low serum IGF-1 and IGFBP-3 that remain abnormally low after GH stimulation, greatest reduction in IGFBP-3
edges.context: human, same 17-patient series; IGF-1, IGF-II, IGFBP-1, -2 and -3 all measured; zone unknown (not reported), sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)
edges.notes: ALS loss disrupts the entire circulating IGF system, not one component.

edges.magnitude: complete absence of PAPP-A2 proteolytic activity in vitro; total IGF-1, IGFBP-3, IGFBP-5, ALS and IGF-II all ELEVATED while free IGF-1 is decreased
edges.context: human, two unrelated families with homozygous PAPPA2 p.D643fs25* or p.Ala1033Val; progressive growth failure, both sexes; zone unknown (not reported), juvenile, pubertal
edges.notes: Inverts the usual biochemical signature of short stature and falsifies the use of total serum IGF-1 as a proxy for IGF-1 action.

edges.magnitude: significant increase in IGF-1 retained within the ternary complex when PAPP-A2 activity is absent
edges.context: human, same two families; size-exclusion chromatography of patient serum; zone unknown (not reported), sex unknown (not reported in source), juvenile, pubertal
edges.notes: Direct human demonstration that the protease liberates IGF-1 from the ternary complex.

edges.magnitude: decreased IGF-I binding in cultured patient fibroblasts; intrauterine and postnatal growth retardation with normal or elevated IGF-1
edges.context: human, compound heterozygote for IGF1R exon-2 Arg108Gln and Lys115Asn, screened from 42 patients with unexplained IUGR plus short stature; zone unknown (not reported), sex unknown (not reported in source), juvenile

edges.magnitude: growth failure from before birth, unlike GH deficiency or GH receptor deficiency which spare prenatal growth
edges.context: human, homozygous partial IGF1 gene deletion; single patient with intrauterine growth retardation, postnatal growth failure, deafness and mental retardation; zone unknown (not reported), sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)

edges.magnitude: 0.09 SD taller adult height per 1 SD higher genetically predicted serum IGF-1
edges.context: human, two-sample Mendelian randomization; UK Biobank IGF-1 instruments against GIANT height excluding UK Biobank across five ancestry groups (n>1.8M), plus ALSPAC ages 7-17; zone unknown (not reported), sex unknown (not reported in source), juvenile, adult

edges.magnitude: 204 cm adult height with incomplete epiphyseal closure and continued linear growth into adulthood, despite elevated estradiol and normal testosterone; lumbar BMD 3.1 SD below the young adult mean
edges.context: human, man homozygous for a disruptive ESR1 mutation, and a woman with an ESR1 variant and estrogen resistance; zone unknown (not reported), sex unknown (not reported in source), adult (28-year-old; 18-year-old)
edges.timescale: growth continues past the normal age of fusion
edges.notes: Establishes in humans that estrogen acting through ESR1, not androgen and not circulating estrogen concentration, closes the growth plate in both sexes.

edges.magnitude: epiphyses unfused at age 28 despite otherwise normal pubertal development
edges.context: human, ESR1-null male with radiographically incomplete epiphyseal closure in adulthood; zone unknown (not reported), adult (28-year-old)
edges.timescale: fusion fails to occur at the normal age
edges.notes: Receptor-side arm of the estrogen-fusion pair; the ligand-side arm is cyp19a1_gene.

edges.magnitude: absent estrogen action with elevated testosterone, androstenedione and 17-hydroxyprogesterone and low estradiol; tall stature in both sexes
edges.context: human, XX and XY siblings with a novel CYP19 mutation, plus four adult aromatase-deficient men; zone unknown (not reported)
edges.timescale: tall stature accrues through failure of timely fusion
edges.notes: Ligand-side arm of the estrogen-fusion pair. Rochira 2010 adds the constraint that these men are tall DESPITE a severely impaired GH response to GHRH-arginine and low IGF-1.

edges.magnitude: only estradiol produced the skeletal response; testosterone did not
edges.context: human, aromatase-deficient man treated sequentially with testosterone and then estradiol; zone unknown (not reported), both sexes (male and female) (sex reported in 1 of 2 sources), pubertal
edges.notes: The intervention arm that closes the loop: it is the estrogen product, not the androgen substrate, that acts on the skeleton.

edges.magnitude: median height SDS -6.3 nullizygous (Langer), -2.4 haploinsufficient (Leri-Weill), -2.1 in SHOX-positive idiopathic short stature

edges.notes: A monotonic 0/1/2-copy human dose series. SHOX has no rodent orthologue, so this series has no animal counterpart to launder.

edges.magnitude: a 170 kb PAR1 interval deleted in 36 short-statured individuals and in none of their normal-height relatives or 30 normal-height rearrangement carriers

edges.magnitude: adult median height -2.8 SDS with advanced bone age; early-onset osteoarthritis in 12 of 20 families

edges.context: human, 17 patients with 14 IGFALS mutations; zone unknown (not reported), sex unknown (not reported in source), age/stage unknown (not reported)

edges.magnitude: 12,111 SNPs explain 40% of phenotypic variance in European-ancestry and 10-20% in other-ancestry populations
edges.context: human, 5.4M individuals of diverse ancestries; out-of-sample prediction; zone unknown (organism-level readout, no zonal resolution), sex unknown (not reported in source), juvenile, pubertal, adult

edges.context: human, 47,135 co-parents from the Norwegian Mother, Father and Child Cohort plus relative-similarity modelling; zone unknown (organism-level readout, no zonal resolution), sex unknown (not reported in source)
edges.notes: Direction is positive: assortment raises trait genetic variance and relative similarity, inflating heritability estimated from relatives. Magnitude specific to height is not published.

edges.magnitude: rare variants contribute 20% and common variants 68% of pedigree heritability; 79% of the rare component is non-coding
edges.context: human, 347,630 UK Biobank whole genomes across 34 traits, plus 333,100 WGS for rare non-coding height signals; zone unknown (organism-level readout, no zonal resolution), sex unknown (not reported in source), juvenile

edges.magnitude: 0 of 3 height GWAS enrichment lists name the GH-IGF/somatotropic axis, which supplies the largest monogenic stature effects (-4 to -10 SDS)
edges.context: human, three published height pathway-enrichment analyses (n=30,147; 183,727; 253,288) compared against the 2023 skeletal disorder nosology; zone unknown (organism-level readout, no zonal resolution), sex unknown (not reported in source), adult
edges.notes: Records the divergence as an observation. The explanatory mechanism is untested and is held at grade E on the target node.

edges.magnitude: 9 of 10 substitutions raise ligand-independent FGFR3 signalling; germline positive selection gives a 2-3 fold enrichment of disease-causing mutations
edges.context: human male germline; 10 FGFR3 missense substitutions assayed by digital PCR across a dissected postmortem testis, donors of varying age; zone unknown (organism-level readout, no zonal resolution), adult (23 to 59 years old/25 years old/68-year-old; 37-year-old/54-year-old)

edges.magnitude: accounts for approximately 60% of Silver-Russell syndrome; severe intrauterine and postnatal growth retardation

edges.magnitude: 14q32.2 hypomethylation lowers IGF2 expression at 11p15.5, producing a transcriptional signature shared with Silver-Russell syndrome
